plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. While collusion or game theory could suggest deviations, with only one round and no prior knowledge of the other bidders' strategies, bidding my true value ($47) maximizes my expected payoff. This avoids leaving money on the table if I win, and minimizes potential losses.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you win if and only if your bid is the highest, and you pay the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values the item more, while bidding more than your value risks winning but paying more than the item is worth to you. Therefore, I will bid my value of $33.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you want to win if and only if your value exceeds the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values the item more, while bidding more than your value risks winning the auction and paying more than the item is worth to you. Therefore, I will bid my value of $36.
